data_sources: SBA Office of Advocacy 2024-2025 Small Business Profiles
metadata.methodology: Synthesized from comprehensive quantitative metrics, industry/geographic segmentation research, and real Chase product offerings. All data internally consistent with 6.0M businesses served and $650B portfolio exposure.

bank_config.name: JPMorgan Chase & Co.
bank_config.market_position: #1 U.S. bank by assets and deposits; #1 small business bank nationally

segments.name: Professional Services
segments.description: Consulting, legal, accounting, marketing, and other knowledge-intensive professional services. High knowledge intensity with stable cash flows.

segments.name: Retail Trade
segments.description: Brick-and-mortar and e-commerce retail operations. Mixed fortunes with e-commerce growth offsetting physical store challenges.

segments.name: Food Service & Restaurants
segments.description: Restaurants, catering, and food production. Full-service restaurants led SBA 7(a) loans in 2024 with $419.4M in funding. High operational intensity.

segments.name: Healthcare Services
segments.description: Medical practices, dental offices, clinics, and healthcare services. Growing sector driven by demographic aging and equipment needs.

segments.name: Construction & Trades
segments.description: Contractors, builders, and trades. Resurgent amid on-shoring subsidies. Top risks include labor shortages, high interest rates, and project disputes.

segments.name: Technology Services
segments.description: Software, IT services, SaaS, and technology consulting. Fast-growing sector with strong fundamentals and low physical capital requirements.

segments.name: Manufacturing
segments.description: Production, fabrication, and assembly operations. Growing with on-shoring subsidies, requiring machinery leases and factory retrofits for automation.

segments.name: Transportation & Logistics
segments.description: Trucking, delivery services, and logistics operations. Equipment-intensive with moderate risk profile and stable growth.

data_quality_notes: Portfolio totals adjusted to Chase's 6.0M business customers (rounded from 6.5M for cleaner dashboard display)
Total exposure of $650B represents Chase's estimated business banking deposits as primary exposure metric
Segment business counts calculated from Chase's 4,827 branch footprint weighted by state business density
Credit scores distributed with portfolio-weighted average of 71.4, consistent with large bank commercial portfolios
Pre-qualified rate of 67% reflects Chase's strong credit quality customer base (above industry 60-70% range)
At-risk rate of 13% includes watch list (12%) + NPL (0.65%) + NCO run-rate (0.28%)
Product names are actual Chase business banking products verified via web research February 2026
Underwriting queue features realistic business names for industry and region (e.g., Pacific Coast Manufacturing in CA)
Sample businesses include realistic name patterns and internally consistent metrics
All dollar amounts use realistic SMB ranges: avg exposure $108K, loan requests $165K-$625K
